_note: 英語島文法分區（最後一批）：數量詞 + of + which/whom（eng.t_sub.relcl.quantifier-of-which，學測級）。事物用 quantifier + of which（some of which），人用 quantifier + of whom（many of whom），逗號後連接、不用 of them（of them 會造成逗號接續 run-on）。形式依 Swan/Cambridge，provisional，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。text-only shadowing、無音檔。

units.title_zh: 數量詞 + of + which / whom（some of which）
units.can_do: 我能用「數量詞 + of which（事物）／of whom（人）」把兩個訊息接成一句：He has three cars, two of which are red；I met ten people, some of whom were teachers，並知道這裡要用 of which/of whom 而不是 of them。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: For things, join extra information with 'quantifier + of which': 'She wrote five books, two of which became bestsellers.'
claims.verification_ref: 事物用 quantifier + of which（two of which became bestsellers）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: For people, use 'quantifier + of whom': 'There were twenty guests, most of whom were students.'
claims.verification_ref: 人用 quantifier + of whom（most of whom were students）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: After a comma that joins the two parts, use 'of which / of whom', not 'of them'. 'of them' would make two separate sentences joined only by a comma (a run-on).
claims.verification_ref: 逗號接續時用 of which/of whom，不用 of them（of them 會造成逗號接續 run-on）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Common quantifiers in this pattern include some, many, most, all, none, neither, one, two, half: 'I read two reports, neither of which was useful.'
claims.verification_ref: 常見數量詞 some/many/most/all/none/neither/one/two/half（neither of which was useful）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: To add extra information about some of a group of things, use 'quantifier + of which': 'She wrote five books, two of which became bestsellers.'
teach.zh_hint: 要補充「一群事物當中有一部分…」的訊息，用「數量詞 + of which」：She wrote five books, two of which became bestsellers.（她寫了五本書，其中兩本成了暢銷書。）

teach.body: When the group is people, use 'quantifier + of whom': 'There were twenty guests, most of whom were students.'
teach.zh_hint: 如果那一群是「人」，就用「數量詞 + of whom」：There were twenty guests, most of whom were students.（有二十位客人，其中大部分是學生。）

teach.body: He owns three shops, one of which is in Taipei. She has many friends, some of whom live abroad.
teach.zh_hint: 他有三家店，其中一家在台北（事物→of which）。她有很多朋友，其中一些住在國外（人→of whom）。

teach.body: Important: in this one-sentence pattern, use 'of which / of whom', not 'of them'. 'The company has 500 workers, many of whom are women.' (Using 'of them' would wrongly join two sentences with only a comma.)
teach.zh_hint: 重點：在這種一句到底的結構裡，用 of which/of whom，不用 of them：The company has 500 workers, many of whom are women.（這家公司有 500 名員工，其中許多是女性。）若用 of them，等於用逗號硬把兩句接起來，是逗號接續的錯誤。

teach.body: I read two reports, neither of which was useful. We interviewed ten candidates, all of whom had experience.
teach.zh_hint: 我讀了兩份報告，兩份都沒用（neither of which，事物）。我們面試了十位應徵者，他們全都有經驗（all of whom，人）。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（事物）：He owns three shops, one ____ is in Taipei.

distractor_rationales.of whom: of whom 用在「人」；商店是事物，用 of which。
distractor_rationales.of them: 用逗號接句子時要用 of which；of them 會造成逗號接續（run-on）。
distractor_rationales.which of: 語序錯了；正確是 quantifier + of which（one of which）。

practice.feedback: 事物＋逗號接續＝of which：one of which is in Taipei。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（人）：She has many friends, some ____ live abroad.

distractor_rationales.of which: of which 用在事物；朋友是人，用 of whom。
distractor_rationales.of them: 逗號接續時要用 of whom；of them 會造成逗號接續（run-on）。
distractor_rationales.whom of: 語序錯了；正確是 some of whom。

practice.feedback: 人＋逗號接續＝of whom：some of whom live abroad。

practice.stem: 選正確形式：The company has 500 workers, ____ are women.

distractor_rationales.many of them: 用逗號把兩部分接起來時要用 of whom；many of them 會造成逗號接續（run-on）。
distractor_rationales.of whom many: 語序不自然；標準寫法是 many of whom。
distractor_rationales.many of which: 員工是人，用 of whom，不用 of which。

practice.feedback: 人＋逗號接續＝quantifier of whom：many of whom are women。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（事物，兩者皆非）：I read two reports, ____ was useful.

distractor_rationales.neither of them: 逗號接續時要用 of which；neither of them 會造成逗號接續（run-on）。
distractor_rationales.none of whom: 報告是事物，要用 of which；of whom 用在人。
distractor_rationales.neither which: 少了 of；正確是 neither of which。

practice.feedback: 事物＋兩者皆非＝neither of which：neither of which was useful。

practice.stem: 選正確形式（人，全部）：We interviewed ten candidates, ____ had experience.

distractor_rationales.all of which: 應徵者是人，要用 of whom，不用 of which。
distractor_rationales.all of them: 逗號接續時要用 of whom；all of them 會造成逗號接續（run-on）。
distractor_rationales.whom all: 語序錯了；正確是 all of whom。

practice.feedback: 人＋全部＝all of whom：all of whom had experience。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀句子，注意逗號後的 of which / of whom 連著唸；一邊讀一邊想「後面那一群是人還是事物」。

lines.text: She wrote five books, two of which became bestsellers.
There were twenty guests, most of whom were students.
